meta.title: Music widget
meta.description: Left-sidebar music widget: a now-playing card with cover art for every media source on this PC, play/pause, previous/next, system volume and mute, other sources, and a collapsible strip with quick controls. Windows only; cover art is looked up through Apple iTunes, Deezer and MusicBrainz/Cover Art Archive when a track changes and falls back to generated artwork.
